tips.text: Crack the Blueprint relics in a four-player Radiant radshare; solo Radiant gives a 10% Rare while four matching players give about 34%.
Leave the Barrel relics Intact; refining them lowers the Common odds.
Recruit a dedicated vaulted-relic squad instead of a public fissure, and check each member's relic before the run.
Use a full squad on Capture or Exterminate fissures for the fastest relics; Void Cascade is slower but less tiring.
Refine each relic before you queue, since the pedestal prompt is easy to forget and burns an Intact relic.
Farm Void Traces on current fissures before cracking a vaulted stack; Varzia's 5 Traces for 1 Aya is a poor rate.
Pick a squadmate's identical reward at the screen; you keep yours and they get bonus Void Traces.
Open Varzia's Next Offering to see the coming rotation before you spend or bank Aya.
Buy every Pyrana Prime relic you can during the window; they never expire, so crack them whenever.
Players call the Aya grind the real cost and the relic cracking a few hours, with the Rare Blueprint the usual holdout.
